operators.name: log_softmax_dim1
semantics: Computes log_softmax along dimension 1 (the class dimension of size 10) for each batch and spatial position.
For each (b, h, w), output[b, c, h, w] = x[b, c, h, w] - log(sum_{c'} exp(x[b, c', h, w])), with numerically stable max subtraction.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device and memory strides.
Equivalent to torch.log_softmax(x, dim=1) for contiguous float32 CUDA tensors.

operators.name: div_scalar
semantics: Performs element-wise division of each element in x by the scalar divisor.
output[i] = x[i] / divisor, where divisor is a Python float cast to float32 scalar in the kernel.
Broadcasting: scalar divisor is broadcast across all elements of x.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device and memory strides.
Equivalent to x / self.divisor in the reference.
Applies log_softmax along dimension 1 of the input tensor.
For each batch and spatial position, subtracts the log-sum-exp over the 10 class elements, with max subtraction for numerical stability.
Output has identical shape, dtype, device, and stride as input.
Divides each element of the log_softmax output by the scalar self.divisor (0.5).
Output has identical shape, dtype, device, and stride as input.
Returns the final tensor after division.
Shape [64, 10, 1024, 256], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0, stride [2621440, 262144, 256, 1].
